full_prompt_en: A square abstract oil painting gathers tangled multicolor brushstrokes across the upper and middle areas of a mostly white canvas. A thin brown frame encloses the work, and a narrow neutral border separates the painted marks from its edges. The upper center contains restless short strokes in dark blue, ocher, dusty pink, purple, olive green, and deep crimson. Some marks are thick and opaque; others are thin, translucent, or scratched back into the white ground. The densest dark passages sit slightly above the center, where cobalt and nearly black lines cross reddish swipes. To their right, a bright yellow-ochre patch expands into a broader, rounded shape, surrounded by lavender, pale gray, and delicate pink marks. On the left, a large soft violet area anchors the lower-middle edge of the cluster. Short orange and mustard strokes fall below it, while slender green-gray and brown lines run diagonally and then drip downward. The bottom quarter remains comparatively open, its creamy white ground interrupted by sparse vertical runs of diluted paint that reach toward the lower edge. Across the top and far right, the same white ground appears between marks, preventing the activity from becoming a solid field. The overlapping strokes suggest a loose central bloom or burst without resolving into literal flowers or figures. Ambient gallery light falls evenly over the canvas, revealing slight ridges of loaded paint, watery passages, and pencil-thin lines; the color itself creates the contrast rather than directional cast shadows. The painting has no readable lettering. Its surface alternates vigorous gestural sweeps with delicate, almost threadlike trails, creating layered depth despite the flat ground. The overall composition feels suspended and improvisational, with warm yellow and red energy balanced by cooler blue-violet knots and large breathing spaces of white.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形抽象油画把缠绕的多色笔触聚在大部分白色画布的上部与中部。细棕框围住作品，窄窄的中性色边界把画痕与外缘分开。上部中央有不安分的短笔触，颜色包括深蓝、赭色、灰粉、紫色、橄榄绿和浓绯红。有些痕迹厚而不透明，有些细薄、半透明，或被刮回白色底层。最浓的深色区域位于中央略上，钴蓝与近黑线条在那里穿过红色笔扫。其右方，明亮黄赭色片块扩展成更宽、更圆的形态，周围有薰衣草紫、浅灰和纤巧粉色笔痕。左侧一大片柔软紫色锚住聚簇的中下缘。短橙色和芥黄笔触落在其下，细长绿灰及棕色线条斜向穿行，随后向下滴落。下方四分之一相对开放，奶油白底面只被稀疏的稀释颜料竖向流痕打断，流痕伸向底缘。顶部和最右侧，白色底面也从笔痕之间露出，使活动区域不至于变成实心色域。重叠笔触暗示松散的中央绽放或爆发，却没有化为字面上的花或人物。均匀画廊环境光落在画布上，显出厚颜料的小小隆起、水性的薄层和铅笔般细线；反差来自色彩本身，而非定向投影。画中没有可读文字。表面在有力的手势性笔扫与近似丝线的纤巧痕迹之间交替，虽有平坦底面仍形成层叠深度。整体构图仿佛悬浮且即兴，以暖黄与红色的能量平衡较冷的蓝紫结点和大块可呼吸的白色空间。
style_prompt_en: The abstract painting leaves broad white ground active around a dense but porous central web of gestural marks. Loaded opaque strokes, thin scratched lines, translucent washes, and downward drips mingle without a rigid outline. Saturated ocher, crimson, cobalt, violet, and olive appear in irregular small islands, with pale gray and pink passages softening their collisions. Dark crossings concentrate above the center, while warmer rounded patches and loose lower trails spread the weight outward. Even ambient light reveals paint ridges and scraped gaps, but the visual brightness comes mainly from white reserve and color contrast. Some marks overlap into layered depth; others remain isolated, preserving air between them. The overall effect is exuberant yet spacious, with improvisational movement held in check by the open ground.
style_prompt_zh: 抽象绘画让宽阔白底在密集却透气的中央手势性笔痕网周围保持活跃。厚而不透明的笔触、细小刮线、透明色洗和向下滴痕混在一起，没有僵硬轮廓。高饱和赭色、绯红、钴蓝、紫色与橄榄绿形成不规则小岛，浅灰与粉色区域柔化它们相撞之处。深色交叉聚于中央上方，较暖的圆润片块和松散的下部拖痕把重量向外扩散。均匀环境光显出颜料隆起和刮开的间隙，视觉亮度却主要来自白色留底及色彩反差。有些痕迹重叠成层次深度，有些孤立存在，保留彼此之间的空气。整体效果热烈却宽敞，即兴的运动被开放底面有节制地承托。
theme_en: An airy abstract painting of tangled multicolor strokes on white
theme_zh: 白底上缠绕多色笔触的通透抽象绘画
name: Joan Mitchell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
